datasheet_identity.title: SSM3J332R TOSHIBA Field-Effect Transistor Silicon P-Channel MOS Type (U-MOSVI)

extraction_notes: This is a p-channel MOSFET. All curve and numeric voltage/current values are represented as positive magnitudes; original datasheet polarity is retained in conditions and specs.polarity = p.

The electrical table publishes RDS(ON) typical and maximum values. The strict schema has one resistance field per row, so each row records the MAX value: 42 mOhm at -10 V/-5.0 A, 50 mOhm at -4.5 V/-4.0 A, 72 mOhm at -2.5 V/-2.5 A, and 144 mOhm at -1.8 V/-0.5 A. Typical values are 36.0, 42.5, 57.5, and 76.5 mOhm respectively.
Threshold is specified as -0.5 V minimum and -1.2 V maximum at VDS = -3 V and ID = -1 mA; no typical table value is published.
Capacitance table values are typical at VDS = -15 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz: Ciss = 560 pF, Coss = 80 pF, Crss = 65 pF. The C-VDS curves are retained separately.

Gate-charge table values: Qg = 8.2 nC, Qgs1 = 1.1 nC, Qgd = 2.2 nC, all typical at VDD = -15 V, ID = -6.0 A, VGS = -4.5 V. Switching times are ton = 15 ns at VDD = -15 V and ID = -2 A, and toff = 75 ns for VGS = 0 to -4.5 V with RG = 10 ohm.
No body-diode reverse-recovery time or reverse-recovery charge is published. Body-diode forward voltage is VDSF = 0.90 V typical and 1.2 V maximum at ID = 6.0 A and VGS = 0 V.

Absolute maximum ratings: VDSS = -30 V, VGSS = +/-12 V, ID = -6.0 A DC, IDP = -24.0 A pulse with PW <= 1 ms and duty <= 1%, PD = 1 W on specified FR4 board, channel temperature 150 degC, and storage -55 to +150 degC.
Drain cut-off current is -1 uA maximum at VDS = -30 V and VGS = 0 V; gate leakage is +/-1 uA maximum at VGS = +/-10 V and VDS = 0 V.
